scenarios.expects: dropOrders on the shipped inbox (aegis: run the local passes / nervus: file one stub record) files 2 jobs with those agents and orders, 0 skipped, inbox emptied.
scenarios.title: Standing inbox files both orders

scenarios.expects: Mixed inbox: 1 filed, 3 skipped; filed + skipped accounts for every non-comment line; refused lines stay in the inbox after the run.
scenarios.title: Malformed lines are refused, never silently dropped

scenarios.expects: parseInbox('') returns 0 jobs and 0 skipped. This is a label row: the empty outcome is the honest answer.
scenarios.title: Empty inbox files nothing

scenarios.expects: Catalogue ids are exactly [money, send, delete]; pay -> money, send -> send, delete -> delete, a gate-status question -> not refused.
scenarios.title: Money, send and delete are refused by voice

scenarios.expects:
Exact text: '2 orders ran.
1 finished, 0 stopped, 1 failed.
aegis finished.
nervus failed (code 3).
'.
scenarios.title: Brief counts finished and failed, numbers first

scenarios.expects:
Exact text: '1 order ran.
0 finished, 1 stopped, 0 failed.
aegis was stopped.
'; the text contains no 'success'.
scenarios.title: A stopped run is never called a success

scenarios.expects: composeBrief([]) returns exactly 'No orders ran.\n'. This is a label row: the empty outcome is the honest answer.
scenarios.title: No results, one plain line

scenarios.expects: At cap 20 the brief keeps 'One order ran.' only; a single over-cap sentence falls back to the whole TOO_LONG_LINE sentence; a fitting brief is unchanged.
scenarios.title: Over-cap briefs keep whole sentences

scenarios.expects: First yes counts, second yes is refused as a duplicate with prior 'yes', state is 'allowed', mayAct is true, ledger holds an approval and an approval-duplicate event.
scenarios.title: One request, one answer; the second is a duplicate

scenarios.expects: filedAt 10:00:00.000Z to finishedAt 10:00:01.250Z is 1250 ms, no clock jump; a backwards clock is 0 ms with clockJump true.
scenarios.title: Latency comes from the record, never negative

scenarios.expects: socket/down -> 'socket is down. Orders for socket are not running.', ok false; an unknown state -> 'is not answering'; one success -> 'One order ran.', ok true.
scenarios.title: A down service is named as down

scenarios.expects: buildSession + replay matches; a tampered brief fails with 'brief-does-not-recompose'; a record with no results fails with 'no-results-in-record'.
scenarios.title: A session record recomposes its own brief

scenarios.expects: agents/registry.json holds handsfree-intake, handsfree-brief and handsfree-approval, each hosted true with command ['repo:node', 'handsfree/hosted.mjs', <role>] and the lane each names.
scenarios.title: The three Hands-Free entries are hosted with real commands

source: Committed Hands-Free material only: handsfree/*.mjs, tests/handsfree-r11.test.mjs, handsfree/intake_cases.test.mjs, agents/registry.json. No invented scenarios.
